question: Which ritual identities correspond to girls aged eight years and nine years respectively?
premises: An eight-year-old girl has a designated identity.
A nine-year-old girl has a designated identity.
inference: An eight-year-old girl is Śāmbhavī and a nine-year-old girl is Durgā.
plain_english: An eight-year-old girl should be regarded as Śāmbhavī, and a nine-year-old girl as Durgā.
